summary_en: The caller first asked for a call tomorrow at 10:00 AM and requested the Python with Data Analytics course fee. The agent stated that the fee is ₹8,999 and said the requested call had been noted. The caller then clarified that they would call later themselves and explicitly asked not to receive a callback. They asked about the SQL course fee; the agent said SQL course details were unavailable and reiterated that the available Python with Data Analytics course costs ₹8,999. The caller confirmed they had received the needed information and ended the call politely. No callback should be made.
objections: The caller declined a callback and said they would call themselves.
